mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lands ( uid, channel_uid, title, intro, img, price, location, stock, norms, recommendhome, details, remark, state, createdtime, updatedtime ) VALUES ( #{uid}, #{channel_uid}, #{title}, #{intro}, #{img}, #{price}, #{location}, #{stock}, #{norms}, #{recommendhome}, #{details}, #{remark}, #{state}, #{createdtime}, #{updatedtime} )
mapper.select: SELECT uid, channel_uid, title, intro, img, price, location, stock, norms, recommendhome, details, remark, state, createdtime, updatedtime FROM lands WHERE uid = #{uid}
mapper.update: UPDATE lands SET channel_uid = #{channel_uid}, title = #{title}, intro = #{intro}, img = #{img}, price = #{price}, location = #{location}, stock = #{stock}, norms = #{norms}, recommendhome = #{recommendhome}, details = #{details}, remark = #{remark}, state = #{state}, updatedtime = #{updatedtime} WHERE uid = #{uid}
update lands set state = 0,updatedtime = now() where uid = #{uid}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM lands WHERE uid = #{uid} and state = 0
mapper.select: SELECT uid, channel_uid, title, intro, img, price, location, stock, norms, recommendhome, details, remark, state, createdtime, updatedtime FROM lands ORDER BY createdtime DESC
